fact: The UDSM DHIS2 Lab reports that a workshop led by the Ministry of Health Zanzibar and the Lab validated end-to-end data flows from point-of-service applications and vertical programme systems into the national HMIS (ZHMIS) through the Zanzibar Health Information Layer, ahead of transition to the live environment; the page text carries no date, so the listing date of 1 October 2025 is used, and it covers Zanzibar only.
title: Advancing Tanzania’s Information Systems Interoperability Agenda
